verdict.rationale: Exporting billing data and porting stored payment methods is a fair question for an invoicing and billing product, so the axis applies. The pack shows Zoho Invoice stores customer card details and can save individual invoices as PDFs, but nothing documents a bulk data export of invoices, subscriptions, or usage records, or any way to migrate stored payment methods to another provider. Per-invoice PDF saving is an adjacent feature, not a portability export.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export every subscription, invoice, and usage record — and port stored payment methods out to another provider — if I choose to leave
